en: A monochrome winter scene showing a historic townscape with a large church or cathedral dominating the left side, featuring a tall tower with a spire. Snow covers the ground and rooftops of surrounding smaller buildings and houses. Leafless trees line the foreground, and the image has a wide expanse of white snow or frozen water at the bottom. Centered below the photograph on the white margin is the caption 'Strengnäs'.
